body.p: In the Office Action dated September 23, 2024, claims 1-20 are pending. The Office Action rejected claims 1-18 under 35 U.S.C. §102(a)(1) for allegedly being anticipated by Kagiya (JP2000249107). Claims 19-20 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. §103 for allegedly being unpatentable over Kagiya.

Claims 3, 19, and 20 are canceled, thereby rendering moot the rejection of those claims under § 103. Independent claims 1 and 10 are currently amended and reasons are presented to overcome the rejection of the claims under § 102(a)(1). New claims 21 and 22 have been added and are supported at least by FIGS. 1-2 of the specification. New claims 21 and 22 do not include new matter. Claims 1-2, 4-18, and 21-22 are in condition for allowance.

Claims 1-2 and 4-18 are novel over Kagiya under §102(a)(1) because Kagiya does not disclose all of the features of independent claims 1 and 10 as currently amended. Independent claim 1, as currently amended, recites (emphasis added):

A pneumatic actuator, comprising: a housing forming both a crank cavity and an actuator cavity; an actuator shaft disposed within the housing and configured to actuate between a first position and a second position; a bushing located within the housing between the housing and the actuator shaft, wherein the bushing is between the crank cavity and the actuator cavity, and wherein the bushing is configured to support the actuator shaft without the actuator shaft being supported at a second location while allowing actuator motion under set operating conditions, wherein the bushing comprises a length to diameter ratio greater than 1; a shaft seal between the housing and the actuator shaft, wherein the shaft seal is between the crank cavity and the actuator cavity; a pneumatic cup connected to a first end of the actuator shaft, wherein the pneumatic cup is within the actuator cavity; and a drive connection assembly connected to a second end of the actuator shaft, wherein the
drive connection assembly is within the crank cavity.

Amended claim 1 is supported by at least FIGS. 1 and 2 and page 12, lines 11-20 of the specification and does not include new matter. Amended claim 10 also includes features similar to the above emphasized features of claim 1.

Kagiya does not include a pneumatic actuator with "a housing forming both a crank cavity and an actuator cavity" and a "bushing is between the crank cavity and the actuator cavity." Rather, Kagiya discloses an actuator 10 with a casing 11 forming a single chamber F. Since Kagiya does not disclose all of the features of independent claims 1 and 10, as currently amended, independent claims 1 and 10 are novel and patentable over Kagiya. The rejections of independent claims 1 and 10 under § 102(a)(1) should accordingly be withdrawn. Notification to that effect is respectfully requested.

Claims 2 and 4-9 depend from independent claim 1 and include all of the features of that base claim. Claims 11-18 depend from independent claim 10 and include all of the features of that base claim. Claims 2, 4-9, and 11-18 are novel over Kagiya for at least the same reasons as claims 1 and 10. The rejection of claims 2, 4-9, and 11-18 under §102(a)(1) should be similarly withdrawn. Notification to that effect is respectfully requested.

An Applicant-initiated interview occurred on February 19, 2025 between Examiner Benedik and Boyd Black (the attorney of record). The above-presented amendments were discussed and Examiner Benedik agreed that the amendments overcome Kagiya under § 102(a)(1).

Claims 1-2, 4-18, and 21-22 are in condition for allowance. The Examiner is cordially invited to contact the undersigned at the telephone number below if it would in any way facilitate the examination of this application.
